newsitem.title: INDIA: India police detain Miss World protesters.
newsitem.headline: India police detain Miss World protesters.

text.p: Indian police detained several opponents of the Miss World beauty contest in Bangalore on Monday as protesters threatened to intensify their campaign against the show.
Police in the south Indian city did not say how many arrests were made in an attempt to stop trouble breaking out later.
Protesters have threatened to lay siege to the venue, the Chinnaswamy cricket stadium, where Miss World will be crowned on November 23.
Members of a militant women's group have said they will commit suicide by swallowing cyanide pills and then setting themselves alight in protest against the Miss World contest.
The Hindu nationalist Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) plans to stage a demonstration at Bangalore's airport where the competitors arrive late on Monday.
Participants will fly in from the Seychelle Islands, where the swimsuit stage of the contest was filmed.
"We will hold a protest at the airport on their arrival," Ananth Kumar, a BJP member of parliament told reporters.
The organisers switched the most revealing part of the pageant to the Seychelles in order to avoid upsetting local sensitivities.
Protesters say the show is an affront to traditional Indian culture.
Indian women have won the international title twice.
Amitabh Bachchan, the popular Hindi actor whose company holds the licence to stage the contest, met the city's police commissioner to discuss security for the show.
